name: dotnet-house

plugins.name: dotnet-house
plugins.description: House conventions for .NET solutions: the portable half of the rules, the decisions that predate any one project, the procedures worth invoking, a reviewer and an explorer that report by path, and two hooks that refuse to start a session on a broken environment or end a turn on a broken build.

description: The portable half of a .NET solution's context, as one installable package: the rule bases' companions, the procedures worth invoking, two agents that report by path, and two hooks that check the environment and the build.
